text:
Maya: quick Q — where's the canonical place to grab p50/p95/p99 and TTFT for a customer slice? need to include tokens/sec for context
Kevin: obs/overview dashboard has the p50/p95/p99 panels, but for slices use the latency-slices dashboard (panel: 'TTFT by slice')
Kevin: quick links: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/obs-overview  and https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/latency-slices?orgId=1
Maya: nice. is there a tokens/sec panel tied to the same query so i can compare throughput vs latency?
Kevin: yes — panel 'tokens/sec (inference)' on latency-slices. set the slice var to the customer id and time window to 15m.
Zoe: if you need raw traces for a slow request use Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/search ; filter by trace tag `slice_id=<id>` and look at the TTFT span
Maya: thx. any recommended quick checklist when p99 spikes? first triage steps
Kevin: short checklist:
- check tokens/sec and inflight requests (panel)
- look at p50/p95 to see if it's a broad shift or tail-only
- check KV cache hit ratio (obs/overview)
- open a sample trace in Jaeger to see model vs network time
- confirm model variant didn't change recently (rollout tab)
Zoe: if it's a burst from a single customer check their rate limiting/ batching config — sometimes crazy prompt sizes kill tokens/sec
Sam: can we add an alert suggestion? current alert fires on p99 > 1500ms which caught noise last week
Kevin: yeah, propose switching to a two-step alert: p99 > 1500ms sustained for 5m -> warning; p99 > 2500ms for 2m -> incident. plus suppress for slices with tokens/sec < 10 to avoid noisy tiny workloads
Kevin: example alert rule (prometheus style):

```
- alert: TTFT_P99_Sustained
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, slice)) > 1.5
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/x/Obs-Runbook
```

Kevin: tweak `> 1.5` to 2.5 for critical or use 2m window for critical fire
Maya: cool. can infra add the suppressed rule for low tokens/sec? we keep getting alerts for very low-volume test slices
infra-bot: ticket created: INFRA-1129 — "Alert tuning: TTFT p99 suppression for low-throughput slices" (assigning to eng-platform)
Sam: pinging @Kevin for a quick review of the rule before infra deploys
Kevin: will add a short PR with the adjusted for/suppression and a note about which dashboards to update
Zoe: also add a dashboard link in the alert annotation so on-call can jump straight to the slice view
Maya: perfect — i can run the first triage if it fires tonight, will post results in here
Sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
